subject: Archaeology
title: Zheng He's Treasure Fleet
description: A short lesson to help you apply Zheng He's Treasure Fleet.

hook.text: China once had the world's largest navy — ships five times bigger than Columbus's — and then destroyed it.

buildup.text: Admiral Zheng He led seven voyages from 1405 to 1433, reaching Africa with fleets of over 300 ships.

discovery.text: Wreck fragments found in Kenya and Sri Lanka match Chinese ceramics and coins from Zheng He's era.

twist.text: After Zheng He died, the emperor banned ocean voyages and burned the fleet's records. China turned inward for centuries.

climax.text: If the treasure fleet survived, China might have colonized Africa before Europe did.

punchline.text: China had the world's biggest fleet and chose to burn it. Europe sailed instead.

quiz.question: What happened to China's treasure fleet after Zheng He's voyages?
options: It was defeated by a coalition of Southeast Asian navies
The emperor banned ocean voyages and the fleet's records were burned
It continued trading under private merchants for another century
